standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma identifying pi_X^{-1} of a torsion sheaf with the rule given by the sections of its small pullback, in the ph-topology

standard_prerequisites.name: Base change, torsion and the ph-covering property of proper morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, the permanence of properness under base change; Same chapter, the comparison of the small and big higher direct images and the torsion of direct images; Topologies, the lemma that a surjective proper morphism is a ph-covering; More on Morphisms, the domination of an fppf cover by a finite one

core_obligations: A'_X is a weak Serre subcategory (proof lines 22342-22359): conditions (1), (2) and (3) of the criterion are immediate because pi_X^{-1} is exact and fully faithful by the cohomological descent lemma; for the extension condition, pushing forward a short exact sequence 0 -> pi_X^{-1}F -> G -> pi_X^{-1}F' -> 0 gives an exact sequence 0 -> F -> pi_{X,*}G -> F' -> 0, so pi_{X,*}G is torsion abelian and G = pi_X^{-1}pi_{X,*}G lies in A'_X.
Property (item-base-change-P) (proof lines 22360-22361): properness is preserved by base change, by the corresponding Morphisms lemma.
Property (item-restriction-A) (proof lines 22363-22366): it follows from the commutative diagram of the big and small etale topoi in the Topologies lemma.
Property (item-A-sheaf) (proof lines 22368-22369): it is the ph-description of the pullback along the comparison.

Properties (item-A-and-P) and (item-refine-tau-by-P) (proof lines 22371-22386): the former combines part (2) of the proper comparison lemma with the torsion of the higher direct images of torsion sheaves; the latter follows because a finite morphism is proper and a surjective proper morphism defines a ph-covering, together with the domination lemma for covering families.
proof_roadmap: Verify A'_X is a weak Serre subcategory, using exactness and fullness of pi_X^{-1}.
Check the base change, restriction and sheaf properties from permanence, the topological diagram and the ph-description of the pullback.
Read the last two properties off the proper comparison with torsion of pushforwards and off the fact that surjective proper morphisms are ph-coverings.
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies the five comparison properties of the standing situation for the ph-topology over the small etale site, with coefficients given by pullbacks of torsion sheaves (statement lines 22321-22339). The proof (proof lines 22341-22386) checks the weak Serre axioms for A'_X via exactness and fullness of the pullback with cohomological descent, and then verifies the five properties one by one from permanence of properness, the topological diagram, the ph-description of the pullback, the proper comparison with torsion of pushforwards, and the ph-covering property of surjective proper morphisms. H2: five property checks with named inputs, all written out.
